test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the smallest among (14)⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾,(12)⁽¹⁾/⁽²⁾,(16)⁽¹⁾/⁽⁶⁾ & (25)⁽¹⁾/⁽¹²⁾?
solution:
Firstly, we have to find the L.C.M. of all the powers so that we can equate the bases.

L.C.M. of 2, 3, 6, 12 = 12

⇒ (14)1/3 = (14)12/3 = (14)⁴

⇒ (12)1/2 = (12)12/2 = (12)⁶

⇒ (25)1/12 = (25)12/12 = (25)¹

⇒ (16)1/6 = (16)12/6 = (16)2

Here, (25)¹ is smallest.

So (25)¹/¹² is smallest.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
